Name: Configurable Animal Products (formerly Faster Animal Products)
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Allows for individual configuration of production speeds for all vanilla animals
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT NEXUSMODS, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Ever wish your dinosaurs had more reliable production?  Get tired of waiting for a rabbit's foot to appear?  Wish your sheep gave wool every day to support your cloth business better?  Now you can configure the length of time each of these animals takes to produce their products once mature!  Many thanks to [zebraoracle](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/1289873) for the idea and to [Moragaine](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/53322671) and [Ria](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/47049574) for testing it.

Update: Ducks added at the request of [Sinmenon](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66044086)﻿! And goats added (along with all other vanilla animals) at the request of [starmsmith](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/stardewvalley/67323996)!

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4.

**IMPORTANT NOTE**
<s>Please note that this mod will only change the production times of new animals.  This seems to be a limitation in the game itself, which is not fixable with Content Patcher. </s>AS OF 1.4, THIS NO LONGER APPLIES!!

Config Options
All vanilla animals have a config option.  You may choose any whole number from 1 to 999 for each animal.  Any number outside this range or any value not an integer will not apply.  You may also leave that animal's config blank to have it default to vanilla behavior.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Faster Animal Products' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once to generate the config.json; quit the game and choose your options if desired.

5.  You're done!
